claim_scores.rationale: Saves a `Predict` with an attached LM, reloads the JSON, injects `data['lm']['api_base']`, and writes it back.
The default `safe.load(path)` is followed by access to `safe.lm.kwargs`, which shows the LM reloaded rather than being unset.
It explicitly asserts `'api_base' not in safe.lm.kwargs` after the default load.
It reloads the same file with `allow_unsafe_lm_state=True` and asserts `unsafe.lm.kwargs['api_base'] == override`.
The only difference between the two loads is `allow_unsafe_lm_state=True`, cleanly demonstrating that unsafe LM-state keys are filtered by default and preserved only with opt-in.
